author: PublixEmployee
body:
Currently, all staff are able to do a command that goes like /go [username]. The command if very useful for the staff to do their job, but it can also be very helpful and make a better user experience for "normal" users too.

Many players come here and play with their friends, and this tool can be great for them to be able to move game-to-game very easily, even if only one person has it.

I'm not sure what donor ranks it best belongs under, so you guys and gals can discuss that in the thread!
